=== Debate: does it accept projekt? / what proj association? ===
app/models/custom/debate.rb:14:  belongs_to :projekt_phase, touch: true
app/models/custom/debate.rb:22:  validates :projekt_phase, presence: true

=== which models still have 'projekt' column vs projekt_phase ===
debate: projekt_id in table? 0 | custom: debate.rb
proposal: projekt_id in table? 0 | custom: proposal.rb
poll: projekt_id in table? 0 | custom: poll.rb
budget/investment: projekt_id in table? 0 | custom: investment.rb

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== Debate: does it accept projekt? / what proj association? ==="; grep -n "belongs_to :projekt\|belongs_to :projekt_phase\|validates :projekt" app/models/debate.rb app/models/custom/debate.rb 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== which models still have 'projekt' column vs projekt_phase ==="; for m in debate proposal poll "budget/investment"; do f="app/models/$m.rb"; cf="app/models/custom/${m}.rb"; col=$(psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -t -A -c "select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_name='$(echo $m | tr / _)' and column_name='projekt_id'" 2>/dev/null); echo "$m: projekt_id in table? ${col:-0} | custom: $(basename $cf)"; done
